## Samsung Galaxy A53 5G Summary

The Samsung Galaxy A53 5G is currently available in the following configuration: 8 GB RAM + 256 GB storage at ₹42,999. The following configurations are currently out of stock: 6 GB RAM + 128 GB storage, with a last known price of ₹20,999, and 8 GB RAM + 128 GB storage, with a last known price of ₹21,999. On the software side, Samsung Galaxy A53 5G runs on Android v12 with Samsung One UI and will receive 4 years of OS updates and 5 years of security updates. Samsung Galaxy A53 5G is built around the Exynos 1280 chipset, Mali-G68 graphics and LPDDR4X RAM. Samsung Galaxy A53 5G records an AnTuTu score of 379,516, along with Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores of 737 and 1,896, respectively. On the display front, Samsung Galaxy A53 5G gets a 6.5-inch Super AMOLED display with 1080x2400 px (FHD+) resolution and a 120 Hz refresh rate. The display also has an aspect ratio of 20:9, and is protected by Corning Gorilla. The physical dimensions of Samsung Galaxy A53 5G are 159.6 mm × 74.8 mm × 8.1 mm (H x W x T), while the device weighs 189 grams. Samsung Galaxy A53 5G carries an IP67 rating for water and dust resistance. Powering Samsung Galaxy A53 5G is a 5000 mAh Li-ion battery type with support for 25W Fast charging. In battery testing, Samsung Galaxy A53 5G records a PCMark battery life of 13h 34m and takes 1h 5m 58s to charge from 20% to 100%. After 30 minutes of gaming, the battery drain is 4%, while the recorded heating is 17%. Samsung Galaxy A53 5G provides 128 GB / 256 GB of internal storage, with support for expandable storage up to 1 TB. For cellular connectivity, Samsung Galaxy A53 5G supports Dual SIM with SIM 1: Nano and SIM 2: Hybrid and works with 5G and 4G networks. For connectivity, Samsung Galaxy A53 5G supports Wi-Fi 5 (802.11 a/b/g/n/ac) 5GHz, MIMO, along with Bluetooth v5.1, GPS with A-GPS and Glonass and NFC. On the audio front, Samsung Galaxy A53 5G supports Dolby Atmos and includes a USB Type-C audio jack. Biometric security is handled by a fingerprint sensor. The rear camera system on Samsung Galaxy A53 5G consists of a quad setup, combining a 64 MP wide angle primary camera, a 12 MP ultra-wide angle secondary camera, a 5 MP macro tertiary camera, and a 5 MP depth quaternary camera. The setup supports OIS and autofocus. Video recording on the rear cameras goes up to 4K @30 fps and Full HD @30 fps. The primary camera supports up to 10x digital zoom. On the front, Samsung Galaxy A53 5G uses a single front camera with a 32 MP primary camera and a wide angle lens. Video recording reaches up to 4K @30 fps and Full HD @30 fps.
